c: Soak kombu in water 1 h; heat in the nabe until just before boiling; remove kombu; add sake.
Guests swish each slice in barely simmering broth (shabu-shabu) until just pink; dip and eat.
Skim scum (aku) between rounds; vegetables and tofu in as space allows.
50 ml goma-dare + 50 ml ponzu with momiji-oroshi and negi per guest.
Shime: season the remaining broth with salt and soy, add udon 2 min; serve in the guests' bowls.

c: Mix to a paste; 1 spoon per pot.
Make a quick chicken stock 1½ h (or anchovy-kelp).
Arrange kimchi, sliced luncheon meat and sausages, mince, beans, rice cakes, tofu, onion and enoki in the pot; paste in the centre.
Pour stock to half height; boil at the table 8–10 min.
Add noodles for 2–3 min; lay a cheese slice on top; serve when it melts.
99b8e519.st: Raw platters 0–3 °C until served, max 2 h at the table; separate raw-meat tongs/chopsticks; burner safety per Table Cooking Spec.

c: Simmer carcasses 3 h; strain; season (soy-based chanko).
Make tsukune from mince and egg; drop into the simmering soup with chicken thigh pieces, root vegetables first.
Add cabbage, enoki, aburaage, tofu, negi; simmer to cook through (≥ 75 °C).
Shime: cook ramen noodles in the remaining soup 2 min.
e0fa3949.st: Raw platters 0–3 °C until served, max 2 h at the table; separate raw-meat tongs/chopsticks; burner safety per Table Cooking Spec.

c: Mix mince with salt until tacky; add minced negi, grated ginger, shredded shiso, egg, starch, soy and sake.
Scoop 25 g dumplings into simmering broth at the table or pre-poach and chill (core ≥ 75 °C).
fc51fa23.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce). Contains eggs, soy, gluten (wheat).

427b1243.yl: Yield: 25 × 90 g pot blocks · Portion: 88 g
c: Soak dried chillies in hot water 20 min; drain; pound coarsely (cijiao).
Melt tallow with oil; fry onion, ginger, garlic to golden over low heat.
Add doubanjiang and fry 15 min until the oil turns red and the paste smells toasty; add chillies, douchi and whole spices; fry gently 20 min (never scorch).
Add Sichuan pepper and rock sugar for the last 5 min; deglaze with Shaoxing.
Rest 2 days chilled; set solid blocks of 90 g; for each pot melt 1 block into 1.5 L bone broth.
427b1243.st: 0–3 °C 1 month; frozen 3 months. Spicy: label heat level.
427b1243.al: 1 Gluten (doubanjiang, shaoxing wine) · 6 Soybeans (fermented black beans) · 14 Sulphites (shaoxing wine). Contains soy, gluten (wheat).

c: Toast white sesame until fragrant; grind in a suribachi to a paste.
Whisk in tahini, soy, vinegar, mirin, sugar and garlic; loosen with cold dashi to a pouring cream.
50 ml per guest in a small bowl; serve with ponzu.
ff24c274.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 4 Fish (dashi) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds, tahini). Contains sesame, soy, gluten (wheat), fish.

c: Loosen tahini with warm water 1 : 0.5 and a pinch of salt and sugar.
Set each base in a labelled bowl with its own ladle and allergen card.
Mince garlic finely (sit in sesame oil as the Chongqing classic); chop coriander and spring onion; crush peanuts.
Card for guests: classic = 2 spoons sesame oil + garlic + coriander + spring onion + a splash of oyster sauce.
435ada69.st: Sauces 0–3 °C 5 days; fresh toppings prepared max 4 h before, kept on ice.
435ada69.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce, chinkiang black vinegar, oyster sauce) · 2 Crustaceans (shacha sauce) · 4 Fish (shacha sauce) · 5 Peanuts (shacha sauce, peanuts) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce, oyster sauce) · 11 Sesame (toasted sesame oil, tahini, sesame seeds) · 12 Molluscs (oyster sauce). Contains sesame, soy, gluten (wheat), peanuts, crustaceans & fish (shacha), molluscs (oyster sauce).

c: Cut cabbage into 5 cm pieces, stem and leaf separate; trim enoki; score shiitake caps (hoshigiri).
Tofu in 3 cm cubes; daikon and carrot 5 mm rounds (flower-cut carrot); negi on the bias.
Arrange by colour on chilled platters ≈ 440 g per guest; cover; 0–3 °C.
96b5b7ca.st: Prep 0–3 °C max 24 h; assemble platters max 2 h before service.

c: Heat basalt stones in a 300 °C oven 2 h; wipe with a little oil; serve on a coarse rock-salt bed (not eaten) in a wooden holder with a warning to guests.
Trim; slice 8 mm against the grain; fan on chilled plates; oil lightly.
Guests sear 20–30 s per side on the stone.
Matcha salt, shichimi salt and plain flaky salt; ponzu with grated wasabi; garlic chips fried golden.
ec4f4aee.st: Raw platters 0–3 °C until served, max 2 h at the table; separate raw-meat tongs/chopsticks; burner safety per Table Cooking Spec. Hot stones 300 °C: insulated holder, never on bare tables.
ec4f4aee.al: 1 Gluten (ponzu) · 6 Soybeans (ponzu) · 11 Sesame (shichimi togarashi). Contains soy, gluten (wheat), fish (ponzu).

c: Push soaked, seeded chillies into holes in the daikon; grate together; drain lightly.
Slice spring onion fine and rinse; grate ginger; portion yuzu kosho and shichimi in small dishes.
Per guest: 35 g momiji-oroshi, 15 g negi, a little ginger, yuzu kosho and shichimi.
9eab3212.al: 11 Sesame (shichimi togarashi). No major allergens (check shichimi blend for sesame).

c: piped into the pot at the table
De-vein; dry prawns well; chop half to a paste and half coarsely; slap the mix on the bowl 50 times until sticky.
Fold in finely diced fat, starch, egg white and seasoning; chill 1 h; pipe from a bag into the broth: cooked when they float (core ≥ 75 °C).
Process ice-cold fish with salt to a paste; beat in chilled water and starch until elastic.
Shape 20 g balls with the hand and a spoon into 80 °C water; poach until they float; chill on ice.
2e3c549f.st: Prawn paste 0–3 °C 24 h; fish balls 0–3 °C 3 days, frozen 1 month.

c: Skin off; slice 1 cm × 12 cm strips; chill.
Guests grill on a hot plate until crisp both sides; cut with scissors into bite pieces.
Wash and spin lettuce and perilla; slice garlic and chillies for grilling.
Sesame-salt dip: sesame oil, salt, pepper; slice onion in soy-vinegar.
Kimchi grilled in the pork fat; wrap pork + garlic + ssamjang in lettuce and perilla.
9950fc5f.st: Raw platters 0–3 °C until served, max 2 h at the table; separate raw-meat tongs/chopsticks; burner safety per Table Cooking Spec.

c: Trim sinew; roll ribeye and belly tightly in film into 8 cm logs; freeze to −4 to −6 °C core (2–3 h).
Slice 1.5 mm on a slicer (rib-eye/striploin for shabu, 2 mm pork belly, 1.2 mm lamb); keep film between layers.
Shingle on chilled plates: 150 g per guest (≈ 70 g beef, 50 g pork, 30 g lamb); cover; 0–3 °C max 4 h.
Loss from trimming ≈ 10–12%; record yield per log.
35501ce7.st: Sliced meat 0–3 °C max 24 h; logs frozen −18 °C 1 month.
35501ce7.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. No major allergens.

c: Induction preferred; butane burners only with full cartridges fitted outside the dining room, 1 spare per 4 tables, CO2 extinguisher and fire blanket in the room.
Pots no more than ⅔ full; broth top-up jug (hot) every 20 min; skimmer, raw-meat chopsticks/tongs (red) separate from eating chopsticks.
Raw platters out max 2 h; guest briefing: pork and chicken cooked through, seafood until opaque, eggs in the pot cooked.
Broth leaves the kitchen ≥ 75 °C; leftover table broth discarded, never reused.
Allergen pots (crustacean-free, sesame-free): separate pot, broth and dips prepared first, labelled.
Children: pots out of reach, extra bowls for cooling; hot stones in holders only.
Clear-down: burners off and cooled before removing; cartridges stored ≤ 40 °C away from heat.
0d20fb12.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Reference card.

c: Roast prawn shells in a dry pan; add carcasses and water; simmer 2 h; strain.
Add bruised lemongrass, galangal, lime leaves, chillies, tamarind; simmer 15 min.
Add tomato and pineapple wedges; season with fish sauce, sugar, lime: sour-hot-salty-sweet.
Serve 1.5 L per pot with seafood platter, rice vermicelli and herbs.
791d3ba8.st: Broth ≥ 75 °C before going to the table; cool unused broth from 60 °C to < 10 °C within 2 h; 0–3 °C 3 days or frozen 3 months. Never reuse broth returned from a guest table.
791d3ba8.al: 2 Crustaceans (prawn shells & heads) · 4 Fish (fish sauce). Contains crustaceans, fish.

c: Make a light chicken broth (2 h) and strain.
Sweat onion, garlic, ginger; add tomato paste 2 min; add chopped tomatoes, ketchup, sugar; cook 20 min to a jammy base.
Add broth; simmer 15 min; blend half for body; season.
Add sweetcorn and serve 1.5 L per pot.

c: Cold-soak shiitake and kombu 8 h; heat to 60 °C 1 h; remove kombu.
Add trimmings, onion, ginger; simmer 1 h; strain.
Season with soy and salt (0.8%); keep the rehydrated shiitake for the pot.
Arrange 250 g fresh mushrooms per pot on the platter; guests add them to the simmering broth.
7c18d892.st: Broth ≥ 75 °C before going to the table; cool unused broth from 60 °C to < 10 °C within 2 h; 0–3 °C 3 days or frozen 3 months. Never reuse broth returned from a guest table.

c: Butterfly short rib off the bone (kalbi) in 5 mm slices; slice harami and ribeye 6 mm against the grain.
Marinate kalbi and harami in yakiniku tare (15% of weight) 30 min; keep ribeye plain with salt and lemon.
Grill on a charcoal or gas table grill; plain salt-and-lemon cuts first, marinated cuts after.
Vegetables in 1 cm slices; offer tare and lemon-salt dips; steamed rice on the side.

c: Boil sake and mirin 1 min; add soy and sugar.
Blend grated pear, onion, garlic and ginger into the liquid; simmer 5 min; cool.
Add sesame oil and toasted seeds. Marinade: 15% of meat weight, 30 min; dip: 30 ml per guest.
b43aaf7d.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (toasted sesame oil, sesame seeds). Contains soy, gluten (wheat), sesame.

c: Season dashi: 1 : 14 soy-mirin; bring to the table in donabe.
Purge clams 2 h in salted water; cut cod and chicken in bite pieces (salt cod lightly 10 min).
Hard ingredients first (chicken, carrot, cabbage stems), then seafood, then leaves; simmer gently until clams open and fish flakes (≥ 75 °C).
Add cooked, rinsed rice to the remaining broth; simmer 3 min; pour in beaten egg; lid 30 s; spring onion.

c: Cover with cold water; bring to 90 °C; simmer 5 h skimming; add ginger, leek and Shaoxing for the last hour.
Strain; season lightly (0.8% salt; guests dip in seasoned sauces).
Add 5 jujubes, 5 g goji and 2 shiitake to each pot at the table.
